Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ ages despite having correct birth data. Eric Mendelsohn was born in 1964 and Harry A. Pollard in 1879; therefore Pollard (Tonight at Twelve) is older. The Planner incorrectly concluded that Judy Berlin has the older director, seemingly conflating Mendelsohn’s current age with Pollard’s age at death and reversing the logical comparison of birth years.
